## PO Status (Ps)

Enum lifecycle for a Purchase Order: draft / pending-approval / approved / sent / partially-received / received / closed / rejected, built on the base `enumField` with its hue map (`PO_STATUS_COLORS`) exported beside it. Transitions are written only by the commands that own them: AwardRfq issues, ApprovePurchaseOrder decides, ReceiveGoods receives.

### Example

A primitive enum field cannot carry `containedExamples` — see the linked PO-2026-0042 (`pending-approval`).

### Non-goals

No "paid" status — payment is out of scope for this app's P2P slice.
